blocks.html: A weekend drive along the Palos Verdes Peninsula tends to follow a familiar arc. You wind past clifftop trails, pause at an ocean overlook, maybe stop for lunch near the harbor, and then realize you’d like to pick up some quality cannabis before heading home. For residents of Rancho Palos Verdes, that last stop has a clear answer just down the hill in San Pedro, where We Roll Up keeps its doors open seven days a week.

blocks.html: Rancho Palos Verdes sits perched above the Pacific, a quiet residential community known for its bluffs, its trails, and its sweeping coastal views. What it doesn’t have is a storefront dispensary of its own, which makes the short trip into San Pedro the most practical option for adults who want legal, lab-tested products. As San Pedro’s first licensed cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up has become the natural destination for peninsula residents looking for something dependable.

blocks.html: The drive from most parts of Rancho Palos Verdes takes only a handful of minutes, and the payoff is access to a curated, hand-picked selection rather than a guessing game. We function as part of the local society, serving recreational users, medical patients, first-timers, and longtime connoisseurs with the same level of attention. Whether you live near the lighthouse or up toward the ridgeline, you’re warmly welcome.
